name: Bad Luck Chuck
source:
Deconstructing the NTR genre by hitting it square in the head! The tour de force no one asked for and everyone is going to hate! Regular high school guy Chuck is finally going to have sex with his new girlfriend Becky, a cult survivor and general ingénue. He's planned it all out for their camping trip.

BUT! OH NO!

On the way, the blooming couple become entangled with the former King and Queen of their high school, graduated and out on a epic tear of indiscriminate sexual aggression. 

Can Chuck squash the undeniable attraction Becky has for these feral, possibly enlightened, sexual demigods? ... Probably not! 

Will he get into a series of farcical sexual mishaps trying? Count on it!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/badluckchuck]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
通过正面痛击寝取题材来解构它！一场没人要求、所有人都会讨厌的精彩表演！普通高中生查克终于要和新女友贝琪发生关系了。贝琪是邪教幸存者，也是个天真的姑娘。他已经为露营旅行做好一切计划。

但是！糟糕！

旅途中，这对恋人遇见了高中时代的前任国王与王后。两人已经毕业，正在进行一场毫无节制的性攻击狂欢。

查克能压制贝琪对这两名野蛮、可能已经觉醒的性半神产生的不可否认的吸引力吗？……大概不能！

他会不会在尝试过程中卷入一连串荒唐的性意外？当然会！
